legal.termsIntro: Welcome to the Hao Thanh Bus app. By using the app to book tickets and experience our services, you agree to the following Terms of Service. Please read carefully.
legal.emptyTerms: No terms of service information available.
legal.termsFooter: For any inquiries or claims related to our services, please contact Hao Thanh Bus Customer Support for prompt resolution.
legal.privacyIntro: Protecting your personal information is our top priority. This Privacy Policy describes how Hao Thanh Bus collects, uses, and protects your data.
legal.privacyFooter: If you have any questions regarding the handling of your personal data, please contact Support.

termsSections.title: 1. Passenger Responsibilities
termsSections.content: Passengers are responsible for providing accurate personal information (full name, phone number) when booking tickets. Passengers must secure their account information and e-tickets.

termsSections.title: 2. Departure and Boarding
termsSections.content: Passengers must be at the pickup point at least 30 minutes before departure on normal days and 60 minutes on holidays. Present valid e-ticket or paper ticket before boarding.

termsSections.title: 3. Luggage and Belongings
termsSections.content: Each passenger is allowed 1 carry-on (under 5kg) and 1 checked luggage (under 20kg). No prohibited goods, weapons, explosives, foul-smelling items, or pets. Passengers are responsible for high-value items.

termsSections.title: 4. Cancellation/Change Policy
termsSections.content: Free cancellation 24 hours before departure. 20% fee for 12-24 hours before. No refund/cancellation within 12 hours of departure or after the bus has departed.

termsSections.title: 5. Schedule Changes by Us
termsSections.content: In case of force majeure (natural disasters, pandemics, traffic jams, sudden technical incidents), we reserve the right to change departure times or bus types. We will notify passengers and offer 100% refund if the new schedule is unsuitable.

termsSections.title: 6. VAT Invoicing
termsSections.content: Passengers requiring VAT invoices must provide invoice information during booking or contact customer service within 7 days after the trip ends.

privacySections.title: 1. Purpose and Scope of Collection
privacySections.content: We collect personal information (Name, Phone, Email) to process bookings, provide transport services, notify schedules, and support customers. This helps us improve service quality.

privacySections.title: 2. Payment Security
privacySections.content: We comply with internet security standards (SSL) and payment card data security standards (PCI DSS). Payment info is processed via reputable gateways and not stored on our systems.

privacySections.title: 3. Commitment to Not Share Info
privacySections.content: We absolutely do not sell or share passenger info with any third party for commercial purposes. Info is only provided to authorities upon legal request.

privacySections.title: 4. E-Ticket Management
privacySections.content: E-ticket data including QR codes is strictly confidential. Please do not share your ticket QR code with strangers to avoid losing boarding rights.

privacySections.title: 5. Customer Rights
privacySections.content: Customers have the right to request access to, correction, or deactivation of their personal account info. Customers can opt out of promotional messages anytime.

privacySections.title: 6. Policy Changes
privacySections.content: We reserve the right to update this privacy policy. Major changes will be notified directly via Push Notifications and updated publicly here.
